project_info.theme: practical-effects surreal summer poolside scene frozen in zero gravity
project_info.color_palette: pool cyan, striped towel yellow and white, ice-cream pastels, beach-ball red-white-blue, and cool shadow blue
project_info.format: vertical wide environmental fashion scene with 25-degree Dutch angle

main_subject.detail: Adult protagonist stands calmly as a detached observer inside a cluttered vintage poolside cabana, wearing a textured one-piece swimwear outfit with modest coverage.
main_subject.style: photographic surrealism with grounded practical-effects detail

items: melting ice-cream cones, retro sunglasses, striped towels, beach balls, and water splashes suspended in mid-air
dense vintage poolside cabana architecture and lounge furniture
dynamic zero-gravity debris field filling the frame without obscuring the protagonist
severe 25-degree Dutch angle for controlled disorientation

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: harsh directional summer sunlight with cool ghostly fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: sharp long shadows across suspended objects, crisp splash detail, bright playful chaos with a slightly uncanny stillness

technical_specs.render_style: deep focus, practical-effects realism, fine Ektachrome-inspired grain and color shift, no CGI gloss

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical surreal summer fashion editorial inside a cluttered vintage poolside cabana, tilted at a severe 25-degree Dutch angle. An adult protagonist in modest textured one-piece swimwear stands calmly as a detached observer while a zero-gravity explosion of poolside artifacts freezes around them: melting ice-cream cones, retro sunglasses, striped towels, inflatable beach balls, and splashes of chlorinated water. Use dense deep-focus composition without obscuring the subject, harsh directional sunlight that casts sharp long shadows, and a cool ghostly fill light. Shoot with a Hasselblad H6D-100c, 35mm lens at f/11; render practical-effects realism, crisp water detail, fine Ektachrome-inspired grain, and no CGI gloss. No text, logo, watermark, nudity, or sexualized framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, child, sexualized pose, nudity, transparent clothing, CGI gloss, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, blurry debris, duplicate objects, extra limbs, deformed, text, logo, watermark
